name: Downsize in place, buying for cash
description: Retire mid-2030, sell the home June 2031 (the §121 exclusion applies), rent 12 months while looking, then buy June 2032 for cash equal to the net sale proceeds. `price: "sale_proceeds"` is a residual claim, not a commitment: living costs come out of the proceeds first and the house gets what survived, which is what stops a 72(t) reserving cash for a purchase that would simply have been smaller.
